entry.title: πRemote 0.1.0
entry.summary: # πRemote 0.1.0 A compact Windows transport and navigation companion for the official Akai Remote Screen. - Independent Force addin. - PLAY, STOP, REC and CONTINUE; hardware view shortcuts, SHIFT/EDIT, track selectors and plugin editing. - Windows panel with high-DPI rendering, remembered IP, one CONNECT/DISCONNECT button and Pin. - Automatic startup after a full Force reboot, verified on the tested installation. - Local command service reached through a dedicated SSH tunnel; no video capture, p
